note: This file is a MMSegmentation configuration file containing only dictionary literals (norm_cfg, data_preprocessor, model). It defines an EncoderDecoder with an ERFNet backbone and FCNHead for semantic segmentation. There are no functions, classes, or callable APIs — it is a list of configuration variables meant to be loaded by the MMSegmentation framework.
summarize_model_config: summarize the ERFNet+FCN semantic segmentation model configuration with 19 classes and SyncBN normalization
review_erfnet_backbone: review the ERFNet backbone configuration with encoder downsampling channels 16, 64, 128 and dilated non-bottleneck blocks
review_fcn_decode_head: review the FCNHead decode configuration with 128 channels and cross entropy loss for 19 segmentation classes
review_data_preprocessor: review the SegDataPreProcessor configuration with BGR to RGB conversion and ImageNet mean/std normalization
review_norm_cfg: review the SyncBN normalization configuration with requires_grad enabled for semantic segmentation training
